name: Mining speed
effect: Always increases correct-tool mining speed.

name: Fortune
effect: Adds stochastically rounded native Fortune levels, capped at III.

name: Magnetized
effect: Pulls only your freshly mined drops toward you, never thrown items.

name: Silk touch
effect: Chance to generate native Silk Touch loot; exclusive with the base Fortune and Smelter families.

name: Reinforced
effect: Increases maximum durability on any reconstructed tool.

name: Scholar
effect: Increases block and furnace experience; suppressed by Silk Touch.

name: Aquatic
effect: Recovers a fraction of the underwater mining penalty.

name: Steady hands
effect: Recovers a fraction of the airborne mining penalty.

name: Long reach
effect: Adds native block interaction range in the main hand.

name: Smelter
effect: Chance to apply the real furnace recipe to each drop, preserving recipe counts and XP.

name: Phasebound
effect: Chance to put final mined drops directly into your inventory; overflow remains in the world.

name: Hardwearing
effect: Chance to prevent each durability point before native Unbreaking.

name: Deep reserves
effect: Adds flat maximum durability, after the Reinforced multiplier.

name: Self repair
effect: Repairs this held tool every ten seconds.

name: Mending affinity
effect: Repairs extra durability on XP pickup without consuming additional player XP.

name: Frugal repairs
effect: Reduces anvil level and material costs on nonempty repairs; costs never fall below one.

name: Nugget maintenance
effect: While crouching, consumes an iron nugget every ten seconds to repair durability.

name: Rain tempered
effect: Repairs every ten seconds while exposed to rain or submerged.

name: Lightweight grip
effect: Adds main-hand movement speed as a fraction of base speed.

name: Braced grip
effect: Adds main-hand knockback resistance.

name: Guarded grip
effect: Adds main-hand armor points.

name: Vital grip
effect: Adds main-hand maximum health points; two points equal one heart.

name: Stonecutter
effect: Increases mining speed while common stone.

name: Ore runner
effect: Increases mining speed while ores.

name: Sediment cutter
effect: Increases mining speed while sand, gravel, clay or dirt.

name: Deep delver
effect: Increases mining speed while blocks below Y=0.

name: Sunstruck
effect: Increases mining speed while daylight with open sky.

name: Night shift
effect: Increases mining speed in low ambient light (below eight), including dark caves.

name: Water cooled
effect: Increases mining speed while rain or water.

name: Heat tempered
effect: Increases mining speed while the Nether or within two blocks of lava.

name: Planted stance
effect: Increases mining speed while standing still.

name: Mining rhythm
effect: Increases mining speed while up to five consecutive breaks less than three seconds apart.

name: Varied strata
effect: Increases mining speed while switching to a different block within three seconds.

name: Last legs
effect: Increases mining speed while less than 25% durability remaining.

name: Calibrated edge
effect: Increases mining speed while more than 75% durability remaining.

name: Prospector
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on any ore; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

name: Gem cutter
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on diamond, emerald or lapis ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

name: Redstone savant
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on redstone ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

name: Coal splitter
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on coal ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

name: Metal splitter
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on iron, copper or gold ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

name: Deep knowledge
effect: Additional mining XP below Y=0.

name: Ore knowledge
effect: Additional mining XP on ores.

name: Experienced rhythm
effect: Additional mining XP during a consecutive mining chain.

name: Experience condenser
effect: Banks half of mining XP and releases the bank on every fifth primary break, conserving total XP.

name: Echoing spoils
effect: Chance to copy one final, non-Silk, non-container drop stack, up to eight extra items.

name: Gem echo
effect: Chance for one extra matching gem; five-second cooldown.

name: Lucky edge
effect: Chance to repair two durability after an ore break.

name: Gravel sifter
effect: Chance: Converts a gravel drop into flint. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Vitrifier
effect: Chance: Converts sand drops into glass. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Clay kiln
effect: Chance: Converts clay balls into bricks. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Stone smoother
effect: Chance: Converts cobblestone into stone. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Slate polisher
effect: Chance: Converts cobbled deepslate into polished deepslate. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Metal filings
effect: Chance: Adds one iron or gold nugget after mining the corresponding ore. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Fossil dust
effect: Chance: Adds one bone meal when mining calcite or tuff. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Web salvage
effect: Chance: Adds one string when cutting cobweb. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Prismatic salvage
effect: Chance: Adds an amethyst shard when breaking an amethyst cluster. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Moss salvage
effect: Chance: Adds bone meal when mining moss. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

name: Vein miner
effect: Mines Connected same-type ore blocks. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Tunneler
effect: Mines A straight line behind the mined block. Crouch to activate. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Broadhead
effect: Mines A plane perpendicular to your view. Crouch to activate. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Stairmaker
effect: Mines A descending staircase ahead. Crouch to activate. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Surface scraper
effect: Mines Nearby matching sediment blocks. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Gravel vacuum
effect: Mines The gravel or sand column above the break. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Branching veins
effect: Mines Adjacent ores, even of different types. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Crystal sweep
effect: Mines Nearby mature amethyst clusters; budding amethyst is never targeted. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Obsidian chisel
effect: Mines Adjacent matching obsidian blocks. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

name: Support mason
effect: Places inventory cobblestone below the mined cell when it is unsupported. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Lightbearer
effect: Places an inventory torch in the mined cell when light is low. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Lava cork
effect: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed lava cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Water cork
effect: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed water cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Bridgework
effect: While crouching, places inventory cobblestone directly beneath your feet. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Green thumb
effect: Consumes bone meal to turn nearby exposed dirt into grass, never replacing other blocks. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Night sight
effect: Grants ten seconds of night vision on a primary break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Prospector sprint
effect: Grants three seconds of Speed I after an ore break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Stone skin
effect: Grants three seconds of Resistance I after a stone break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Fire ward
effect: Grants three seconds of fire resistance after mining near lava.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Gem ward
effect: Grants four seconds of Absorption I after a gem ore break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Soft landing
effect: Grants three seconds of Slow Falling after an airborne break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Echo chamber
effect: Slows nearby hostile mobs after an ore break; never targets players or animals.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Quarry mark
effect: Makes nearby hostile mobs glow after an ore break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Desperate pulse
effect: At less than four hearts, knocks nearby hostile mobs away after mining.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

name: Air pockets
effect: Restores air ticks on underwater primary breaks.

name: Miner sustenance
effect: Chance to restore one food point; ten-second cooldown.

name: Recoil step
effect: Crouch mining steps you safely backward into loaded, collision-free space; ten-second cooldown.

name: Resonant battery
effect: Generates resonance on primary breaks; capacity 100.

name: Overcharge
effect: Consumes four resonance on a primary break for temporary Haste I; ten-second cooldown.

name: Gem battery
effect: Generates extra resonance on gem ore breaks.

name: Kinetic battery
effect: Moving at least one block while holding the tool generates one resonance, at most once every three seconds.

name: Experience battery
effect: Converts one point of the current mining XP into resonance, never generates XP.

name: Quarry discharge
effect: Spends five resonance to mine a cross around a primary break. Shared area budget applies.

name: Spoils discharge
effect: Spends three resonance to duplicate up to four items from one final drop; non-Silk, five-second cooldown.

name: Mending discharge
effect: Spends four resonance to repair the tool; ten-second cooldown.

name: Shared momentum
effect: Spends six resonance to grant Haste I to nearby allied players; ten-second cooldown.

name: Alternating current
effect: Alternating ore and stone breaks within three seconds generates resonance.

name: Knowledge siphon
effect: Grants mining XP directly, suppressing its orbs; this bypasses vanilla orb-based Mending.

name: Apprentice resonance
effect: Chance to grant one extra tool XP after a valid primary break; ascension gates still apply.

name: Careful mason
effect: Chance not to consume the material for a successful utility placement; you must still own it.

name: Precision silk
effect: Silk Touch chance while standing still. Shares the base harvest exclusion group.

name: Pocket press
effect: Converts nine plain inventory ingredients into one block or ingot after mining; never processes named or component-bearing ingredients.
milestones: Raw iron/gold; then copper; then coal/redstone/lapis; then diamonds/emeralds. Five-second cooldown.

name: Spoils ward
effect: Temporarily prevents damage to your final mined drops via the native invulnerability-check event; underlying entity flags remain unchanged.

name: Choking dust
effect: Mining sediment weakens nearby hostile mobs for three seconds; ten-second cooldown.

name: Pyroclastic
effect: High smelting chance; successful furnace processing also increases furnace XP.

name: Cinder chain
effect: Successful smelting generates resonance.

name: Soul furnace
effect: Spends one player XP to smelt all eligible drops of a primary break; never overrides Silk Touch.

name: Basalt heart
effect: Nether stone breaks grant Resistance I and repair durability; ten-second cooldown.

name: Magma reservoir
effect: Mining near lava generates resonance.

name: Soul cleanse
effect: Mining soul sand or soul soil removes Poison, Wither, Slowness or Weakness; ten-second cooldown.

name: Piglin purse
effect: Chance for one extra gold nugget on gold ores; never triggers on Silk Touch.

name: Ghast breath
effect: Spends five resonance to knock away and ignite nearby hostile mobs; ten-second cooldown.

name: Emberlight
effect: Spends two resonance to create a soul torch in a dark mined cell; placement events still apply.

name: Infernal echo
effect: Spends four resonance to break additional connected Nether ores; shared area limit applies.

name: Chorus hop
effect: Spends four resonance to safely teleport forward when crouch mining; ten-second cooldown.

name: Ender dispatch
effect: After Phasebound, sends overflow drops to your Ender Chest; full storage leaves exact remainders in world.

name: Repulsor
effect: Knocks nearby hostile mobs away after an ore break; ten-second cooldown.

name: Entanglement
effect: Spends two resonance to give one resonance to a nearby allied player's reconstructed pickaxe; ten-second cooldown.

name: Temporal echo
effect: Spends three resonance to prime a duplicate of one item on the next primary break within ten seconds; non-Silk only.

name: Shulker pulse
effect: Spends five resonance to levitate nearby hostile mobs; ten-second cooldown.

name: Endstone alchemy
effect: Spends five resonance for a 15% chance of one pearl when mining End Stone; ten-second cooldown.

name: Void anchor
effect: Spends twenty resonance to return you to the last safe position recorded while holding this tool in this dimension; sixty-second cooldown.

name: Dimensional battery
effect: Successful Phasebound collection generates resonance once per primary break.
